mapper.select: SELECT id,tenant_id,error_code,finished_at FROM inventory_export_tasks WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{taskId} AND status='FAILED' AND finished_at >= #{start} AND finished_at < #{end} AND error_code IN ('TIMEOUT','WORKER_LOST','IO_FAILED','QUERY_FAILED','DISK_LIMIT') FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM alert_event_sources WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND rule_id=#{ruleId} AND task_id=#{taskId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM alert_events WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND rule_id=#{ruleId} AND error_code=#{code} AND open_slot=1 AND status IN ('OPEN','ACKNOWLEDGED') FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE alert_event_sources SET event_id=#{eventId} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND rule_id=#{ruleId} AND id=#{sourceId} AND event_id IS NULL

UPDATE alert_events SET occurrence_count=#{event.occurrenceCount},latest_task_id=#{event.latestTaskId}, owner_user_id=#{event.ownerUserId},last_seen_at=#{event.lastSeenAt}, recovery_status=#{event.recoveryStatus,javaType=com.equipops.domain.enums.AlertRecoveryStatus,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, recovered_at=#{event.recoveredAt},version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{event.tenantId} AND rule_id=#{event.ruleId} AND id=#{event.id} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND open_slot=1 AND status IN ('OPEN','ACKNOWLEDGED')
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM alert_notifications WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND event_id=#{eventId} AND recipient_user_id=#{recipientId} AND status='DELIVERED' ORDER BY delivered_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT m.id FROM tenants t JOIN tenant_memberships m ON m.tenant_id=t.id JOIN users u ON u.id=m.user_id JOIN tenant_member_roles mr ON mr.tenant_id=m.tenant_id AND mr.membership_id=m.id JOIN roles r ON r.id=mr.role_id WHERE t.id=#{tenantId} AND u.id=#{recipientId} AND t.enabled=1 AND m.enabled=1 AND u.enabled=1 AND r.role_code='TENANT_ADMIN' LIMIT 1 FOR SHARE
SELECT id FROM alert_notifications WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND delivery_key=#{deliveryKey} FOR UPDATE
